oracle.independence_basis: The generator rebuilds the test's noiseless series from the stated equation and recovers the lag-1 slope by exact rational least squares on the float sample values; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated lag-1 equation: the test builds the series from the pinned effect, so this reference only confirms the pinned value is what a lag-1 regression of this series returns.
oracle.historical_exposure: The original values were pinned in an earlier import whose harness was not retained; this reference was written during this review from the fixture formula and declared inputs, with the executing assertion read to establish which values it compares and no product implementation source consulted. Who first derived the pinned numbers is unrecorded.

reference_review.redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and deterministic inputs. Python standard library only, in an isolated locked script environment, outside the product and ordinary CI; no upstream source is stored.
reference_review.limitations: Noiseless and deterministic, so the posterior mean recovers the coefficient up to prior shrinkage and the 0.05 band is a declared tolerance; nothing is shown about autocorrelated noise, misspecified lags or interval coverage. The report-presence flags are contract settings. No calibration claim.
